Name: Sen says happy birthday(Lurking in the Dark Happy Birthday Content Pack)
Author: passersby10086
Description:
[size=4]        生日快乐是一个很有趣的mod，它允许玩家选择自己的生日。在这一天，如果npc聊天，你会收到生日祝福和一份礼物。如果你没有和他们聊天，和你关系很好的居民会在第二天用信件送上祝福和礼物。并且，还能为喜欢的npc编写独特的祝福语。[/size][size=4]       
        我为Sen编写了一套生日祝福，我想它应该和Sen的人物设定足够契合。目前有中文和英文两个版本，请自行下载对应语言的版本。

[/size][size=4]Happy Birthday is a very interesting mod that allows players to choose their own birthday. On this day, if the npc chats, you will receive birthday wishes and a gift. If you haven't chatted with them, the residents who have a good relationship with you will send you blessings and gifts by letter the next day. Moreover, you can also write unique blessings for your favorite NPCS.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]I wrote a set of birthday wishes for Sen. I think it should be in line with Sen's character setting well enough. Currently, there are two versions available: Chinese and English. Please download the corresponding language version by yourself.[/size]
